{'根據彭博記者 Mark Gurman 報導，Apple 正為旗下零售店進行重大調整，以迎接即將推出嘅 Home 系列產品。Apple 預計最快會喺今個秋季推出更新版 HomePod mini 同 Apple TV 4K，但從相關變動嚟睇，應該仲有第三款、更具份量嘅產品蓄勢待發。': 'According to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman, Apple is making significant changes to its retail stores in preparation for the upcoming Home product lineup. Apple is expected to launch updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K as early as this fall, but based on the related changes, there appears to be a third, more substantial product in the pipeline.'}

{'Apple 嘅 Home 系列產品積壓已久，主因係涉及 Siri 嘅改造工程一再延期。而家 Siri 終於搞掂咗，我哋應該好快就可以見到部分產品面世，結束多年嚟冇更新嘅局面。': "Apple's Home product lineup has been long overdue, primarily due to repeated delays in the Siri overhaul project. Now that Siri is finally done, we should soon see some of these products come to market, ending a multi-year drought of updates."}

{'不過之前有報導指出，Apple 會率先推出更新版 HomePod mini 同 Apple TV 4K，旗下首款智能家居中樞（又稱為配備屏幕嘅 HomePod 或 HomePad）可能會稍後先至登場。': 'However, previous reports indicated that Apple would first release updated versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K, with its first smart home hub (also known as a HomePod with a display or HomePad) potentially arriving later.'}

{'然而，依家睇嚟智能家居中樞好可能會同升級版 Apple TV 同 HomePod mini 同步推出，至少從零售店嘅籌備工作嚟睇係咁。節錄自 Power On 電子報：': 'However, it now appears that the smart home hub may launch simultaneously with the upgraded Apple TV and HomePod mini, at least based on the preparations underway at retail stores. Excerpt from the Power On newsletter:'}

{'當然，要到 Apple 九月嘅發布會先至會有確實答案。但根據今日嘅報導，我哋好快就有機會一睹 Apple 全新型號智能家居中樞嘅廬山真面目，同時仲有支援 Siri AI 嘅新版 Apple TV 4K 同 HomePod mini。': "Of course, we'll have to wait until Apple's September event for definitive answers. But based on today's report, we may soon get a glimpse of Apple's all-new smart home hub, along with new versions of the Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini with Siri AI support."}

{'總結': 'Summary'}

{'提提大家，Apple 嘅智能家居中樞據傳會配備 7 吋方形屏幕，並提供兩個版本：一款內置喇叭，另一款機背附有磁鐵，可以磁吸方式掛牆安裝。產品將運行全新作業系統，主畫面會有 widgets 小工具，除咗可用嚟打 FaceTime 視像通話之外，顧名思義亦會成為你所有智能家居配件同 Siri 嘅中樞。處理器方面，將會採用 A18 晶片。': "As a reminder, Apple's smart home hub is rumored to feature a 7-inch square display and come in two versions: one with built-in speakers, and another with magnets on the back for wall-mounting. The product will run an entirely new operating system with widgets on the home screen, and as the name suggests, it will serve as the hub for all your smart home accessories and Siri—not to mention making FaceTime video calls. It will reportedly be powered by an A18 chip."}

{'Home 系列嘅另一個新傳聞係，新版 Apple TV 4K 可能會配備全新嘅 Siri Remote，但暫時未知具體會有咩改動。': 'Another new rumor about the Home lineup is that the new Apple TV 4K may come with an all-new Siri Remote, though specific changes remain unknown for now.'}

{'你有冇興趣入手新嘅 Home 產品？邊樣最令你期待？歡迎喺留言區分享你嘅睇法。': 'Are you interested in picking up any of the new Home products? Which one are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.'}
